thread:
alice: Heads up — deploybot just paused the EU rollout for the 16:00 deploy due to an incident. Can we confirm ops handback window and who updates release notes?

deploybot: Deployment pipeline paused (INC-2024-1123). Affected tag(s): v3.4.2.*. All rollouts blocked until explicit resume.

roberto: Ack. I'm looking at control-plane logs now.

sre-oncall: Autoscaler flapping in eu-west-1 caused transient 503s to the control plane. Impact: canaries failing health checks. ETA to stabilise: 45m - 2h depending on scaling.

maya: Recommendation: pin production to v3.4.1 for rollback safety. Also we should update release notes to include rollback command and known issue (autoscaling).

alice: I can draft the release-notes patch. Want to include exact rollback CLI. @ben can you sign off?

ben: Taking ownership of release notes sign-off. I'll add a section "Incident rollback steps" and link to the incident doc. Will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

roberto: Ops handback proposal: tentative resume at 19:30 UTC if health is green, otherwise move to tomorrow's 02:00 UTC maintenance window. If we resume, reduce canary to 5% and monitor for 30m before full ramp.

sre-oncall: Agreed. Config changes to apply before resume: `canary_percent=5`, `circuit_breaker=on`, and fallback route to `v3.4.1` enabled. If any 5xx spike > 1% in 5m, auto-rollback.

deploybot: Executing requested pre-resume changes:
```
set_config canary_percent=5
set_config circuit_breaker=on
enable_fallback v3.4.1
pause_until 1712356200  # tentative resume timestamp
```
Action results: canary_percent=5 ✅, circuit_breaker=on ✅, fallback=v3.4.1 ✅.

alice: Thanks. I'll land the release-notes PR with the rollback section and the tentative resume time. @ben please review ASAP.

ben: Reviewing now. Will comment by EOD. If we need to push longer, prefer tomorrow 02:00 UTC window.

maya: Also add a short blurb in the release notes for customers: "We're pausing the rollout to investigate an autoscaler-induced control-plane instability; we'll resume when metrics are stable." Keep it concise.

roberto: I'll keep monitoring and post a health update every 20m. Will call for resume if green.

alice: Cool — leaving follow-ups here. Thanks everyone.
